source_name: Bolagsverket — Värdefulla datamängder API v1 — /dokumentlista + /dokument/{id} (annual reports, iXBRL)
license: Free of charge, no contract — EU high-value datasets (2019/1024); annual-report document files may carry specific reuse wording — verify.
data_freshness: real-time as filings are submitted; per fiscal year
record_shape: two-step: POST /dokumentlista (by orgnr) -> list of document metadata; GET /dokument/{id} -> ZIP containing one annual report as iXBRL (inline XBRL) tagged to Swedish K2/K3 taxonomies (taxonomier.se)
_observation_basis: NO authenticated document was retrieved (OAuth-gated). The financial concepts below are the standard Swedish K2/K3 iXBRL annual-report line items named in schema_notes.md and taxonomier.se. The XBRL concept (element) names, contexts, units, and decimals MUST be read from the actual iXBRL instance with an XBRL parser keyed to the K2/K3 taxonomy; the Swedish labels below identify the concept, not a literal JSON key.

fields.meaning: Identifier of an available document (e.g. an annual report) used to download it via GET /dokument/{id}.
fields.limitations: Exact key name and metadata shape unverified (OAuth-gated).
fields.analysis_notes: Iterate the document list and pick the latest annual report per fiscal year.

fields.meaning: Type of the filed document, e.g. årsredovisning (annual report).
fields.analysis_notes: Filter to annual-report types for financial extraction.

fields.meaning: Financial year the document pertains to.
fields.limitations: May be a year, a start/end pair, or a filing date; unconfirmed.
fields.analysis_notes: Key financial records by fiscal year; one report can cover a non-calendar fiscal year.

fields.meaning: Reporting period (start and end dates) of the annual accounts inside the iXBRL instance.
fields.limitations: Read from the XBRL context (period start/end), not a flat field.
fields.analysis_notes: Use the XBRL period context to date each financial figure.

fields.meaning: Reporting currency of the financial statements (usually SEK; can be EUR/USD).
fields.limitations: Read from XBRL unit (measure). Do not assume SEK without checking.
fields.analysis_notes: Carry currency on every financial figure.

fields.meaning: Swedish accounting framework applied (K2 simplified or K3 main-rules), which determines the taxonomy and available line items.
fields.limitations: Determines which concepts exist; some line items present only under K3.
fields.analysis_notes: Select the correct taxonomy concept mapping per framework.

fields.meaning: Net turnover / net revenue for the period (income statement).
fields.limitations: Small companies may omit revenue under abbreviated K2 reporting. Read XBRL decimals/scale.
Derived/aggregated concept; presence depends on statement layout.
Concept name varies slightly across taxonomy versions.

fields.meaning: Net profit/loss for the financial year.
fields.limitations: Bottom-line result; sign convention per XBRL.
Read at the balance-sheet date context.
fields.analysis_notes: Balance-sheet total; basis for soliditet derivation.

fields.limitations: Equity sub-components available separately under K3.
fields.analysis_notes: Used to derive soliditet = equity / assets downstream.

fields.limitations: May need to be summed from kortfristiga + långfristiga skulder if a total concept is absent.

fields.meaning: Fixed assets and current assets subtotals of the balance sheet.
Whether the accounts were audited / presence of an auditor's report.
fields.limitations: Many small Swedish AB are exempt from audit; absence ≠ irregularity. Inference from presence of an auditor section.
fields.analysis_notes: Flag audited vs unaudited where determinable.

fields.meaning: The actual XBRL element/context/unit names as they appear in the iXBRL instance.
fields.limitations: Concept names differ across taxonomy versions/years; keep the raw mapping alongside normalized figures.
fields.analysis_notes: Persist the raw parsed iXBRL → concept map so re-normalization is possible without re-downloading.
